authority: project-provided adapter based on supplied official CPU baseline; platform confirmation pending

environment.ITE_PARENT_HISTORY: optional history JSONL bound to the supplied parent

prediction_input: one JSON object per line, only task (optional) and inputs, no labels
prediction_output: A: outputs array of label/score; B/C: outputs.value in original target units
training_input: official id/inputs/answer JSONL; gradients only from explicitly supplied train
history_policy: preserve supplied bound history; seen validation IDs cannot become fresh future labels
initial_baseline_history: preserve exact original official history only if the supplied checkpoint digest matches that baseline
missing_resume_parent_history: retain the supplied parent; never reset previously used validation accounting
policy: existing A step7 replay, B static, C head_only epoch2; no synthetic feature drift
